newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana okays GO bond defeasement plan.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana okays GO bond defeasement plan.

text.p: The Louisiana Bond Commission approved a proposal Thursday to use $363.2 million of surplus revenues to defease general obligation bond debt.
"We'll be defeasing about $391 million in debt service over the next four years," Commission Director Gayla Chapman said.
The plan will use about $318 million of surplus revenues from fiscal 1996, and about $45.2 million from fiscal 1997 to reduce debt service costs in future years, using Treasury-backed escrow funds.

The commission also gave final approval Thursday for 10 state agency and local government bond issues totalling about $103.8 million. Several of the deals involved refunding components. Approved were:
--$39 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority revenue refunding bonds for construction of housing and dormitory services at Xavier University of Louisiana.

--$29 million Louisiana Public Faciliites Authority revenue and refunding bonds for the Woman's Hospital Foundation, to refund its 1998 and 1992 series and finance expansion at the hospital in Baton Rouge.
--$14 million Ascension Parish Council industrial revenue bonds for construction of solid waste and sewage disposal facilities at the BASF Corp's Geismar plant.
--$9.6 million Board of Trustees for State Colleges and Universities lease revenue bonds, for construction of the Cajundome Convention Center at the University of Southwestern Louisiana.
--$5.5 million Ascension Parish Council industrial revenue bonds for a wastewater treatment facility at Allied Signal Corp's Geismar plant.
--$3.5 million City of Covington public improvement sales tax refunding bonds, refunding its 1990 series.
--$1.9 million Louisiana Public Facilities Authority industrial development revenue bonds to buy and equip a steel fabrication shop for Southland Steel Fabricators Inc in Greensburg.
--$1.1 million City of Scott public improvement sales tax refunding bonds, for advance refunding of certain maturities from its ST-2 series.
--$125,000 of Jeferson Parish Hospital Service District No. 2 hospital revenue bonds for construction of a garage and improvements at East Jefferson General Hospital.
--$60,000 of Town of Winnsboro utility revenue bonds for improvements and extensions.
